svg.title: Place the covered conical flask in the bath · sample A
svg.desc: Put this solution into its own covered conical flask and place the flask in a sonication bath. A and B are separate solution branches, not sequential treatments of one batch. Vessel capacity and cover construction are not reported. Source-bound concept; apparatus geometry illustrative, not measured.
